title: GET {portal}/l/{space}/store-sign-in/{outlet} query (hosted portal page, browser redirect)
description: The store's 'Sign in with the member portal' button sends the shopper here (the heartbeat's branding.sign_in_url, which already names the portal and the outlet). A member not signed in to the portal signs in or registers first and comes back here. Pixalink then mints a portal sign-in ticket bound to sha256(state) and redirects to `return` with `pixalink_sso=<ticket>` added. `return` must be an absolute URL on the outlet's connected store host; anything else is refused without a redirect. `state` is the random value the store keeps in its own short-lived cookie and sends back as `sso_state` when it redeems the ticket (customers-create.request.json), so a ticket only works in the browser that started the sign-in. All values arrive as strings.
